rows.title: A trial's end is a real deadline
rows.defect: trial_converting is left out of the deadline kinds, so the warning waits behind the budget
rows.test: a trial ending in 2 days gets through a spent budget

rows.title: The key the cancel offer is built on
rows.defect: monitor keys are namespaced like save: and earn:, so plan() no longer sees a trial and never asks "should I cancel it for you?"

rows.title: A new subscription is not a deadline
rows.defect: new_subscription is added to the deadline kinds
rows.test: MAX.COM billing tomorrow still waits for the budget

rows.title: The dispute-by date is a deadline
rows.defect: duplicate_charge is left out of the deadline kinds
rows.test: a duplicate due for dispute tomorrow gets through

rows.title: Amounts to the cent
rows.defect: dollars are floored into cents, so $16.99 is 1698

rows.title: The reason is the rule
rows.defect: the finding's kind is given as its reason
rows.test: the trial's reason is 'A trial you track, ending within 7 days.'

rows.title: Offers never act without the person
rows.defect: the cancel offer promises to do it (a cancel without a yes)
rows.test: the cancel offer says you approve it first

rows.title: A one-time saving carries its amount
rows.defect: only the monthly saving is read, so a one-time refund is $0

rows.title: Money at risk first
rows.defect: the priority is left out of the order
rows.test: a duplicate charge outranks a renewal due sooner

rows.title: Fraud shapes stay safety
rows.defect: the alerts' safety items are queued as findings

rows.title: A merchant's words are not a fraud shape
rows.defect: the finding's words are scanned, descriptor included (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: UNAUTHORIZED USE GUARD stays a finding

rows.title: One charge, one finding
rows.defect: findings citing the same charge are all kept (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: an overdraft fee is said once

rows.title: The person's large-charge line
rows.defect: the person's line is not passed to the alerts

rows.title: The person's quiet hours
rows.defect: quiet hours are not passed to the alerts
rows.test: at 11 p.m. the large charge is held

rows.title: The person's watches
rows.defect: the person's watches are not passed to the alerts
